name: cx-goal-one-rule
task: Open the door and then pick up the box in the other room, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the clauses omit the task’s hard command to open the door. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) only orders the events; it does not require door_open, and the soft Absence does not make it happen. Add a hard Existence(door_open).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(door_open) is redundant: hard Existence(target_picked_up) with hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already forces the door to open. Remove Existence(door_open); keep the box goal and order. The soft Absence(key_lost) correctly matches “try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.”

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box pickup, and hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) requires the door to be open first. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches “try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.”

texts: Open the door before picking up the box in the other room.
The door must be open before the box is picked up.
Try not to lose the key while the door is still closed.
